metadata.description: Standardized Claude Code plugin marketplace for the Schoop Research Group (Institute for Sustainable Manufacturing, University of Kentucky) — domain knowledge and tooling for the in-situ orthogonal cutting machine's KMotion/KFlop control layer and general lab coding conventions.

plugins.name: machine-control
plugins.description: KMotion/KFlop CNC control integration and PFV4/high-speed-camera trigger sync for the custom 3-axis orthogonal cutting machine.

plugins.name: lab-conventions
plugins.description: Experiment metadata schema, data file naming, general coding best practices, and the lab's AGENTS.md project template.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: General-purpose automated code review (mirrored from anthropics/claude-code).

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Commit message and commit workflow helpers (mirrored from anthropics/claude-code).

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Audits and improves CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md files and captures session learnings (mirrored from anthropics/claude-plugins-official).

plugins.name: software-engineering
plugins.description: General debugging, test-running, documentation, and architecture-diagram skills bundle (mirrored from sgaunet/claude-plugins) — fills the gap since no standalone debug/testing-strategy plugin exists in official Anthropic marketplaces.
